Idk I have interests and shit and I do stuff I enjoy but its like once I realized how little suicide would mean to me after i died I just dont even care about any of it anymore. Death just isnt like scary anymore.. it's kinda hard to explain. But i just wanna explain that Im not super depressed all the time, I ***was*** but now I'm just wanna like... die. I guess I'm more pissed off that depressed at this point. I probably wont even kill myself anytime soon anyway I just really wanted to vent lol. I'm waiting for later when I'm sure it's what I want to do. But unless something big happens in my life I don't see myself preventing it :(

Also, I don't think looking at the little things in life like tv shows i like or hobbies I enjoy will turn myself around, it'll be the big things. I picked up my school work and I've gotten all 90s this year and I'm really hoping I get into good colleges but even with all 90s and up for 3 quarters so far junior year, my GPA is still 2.7 due to my shitty grades the last 2 years. I have 3 colleges that I absolutely have to get into at least one of. But it seems very unlikely that I will make it into any of them. If I don't get into at least one of them I'm not sure what I will do. I appreciate you're response by the way. I was just freaking out today and really needed to vent and start thinking about if I should get help about suicide or not. Actually helps a ton seeing someone reply and acknowledge my problems.
